note: One page per CTA example: /cta/<company> (507; e.g. /cta/get-ripe = 'Get-ripe | Call-to-Action Design Inspiration'). /categories/<kind> lists the examples of one kind (8 kinds); only 'form' names a cta variant (with-form), the rest are content kinds (button, download, navigation, pricing, newsletter, modal-pop-up, call-to-buy) with no taxonomy variant. /industry/ (25) and /mode/ (light, dark) are filters, not variants.
